imps.title: Multilingual NLP needed
imps.detail: Taglish code-switching; Bisaya+Cebuano ~22.5% of households [EST]; Hiligaynon, Ilocano, Waray, Bikol, Maguindanao etc. Include local terms (lagnat, sinat, tawa-tawa). Filipino LLM benchmark Batayan exists; regional languages low-resource.
imps.dZh: 他加祿英語混用（Taglish）；Bisaya＋宿霧語約 22.5% 家戶 [EST]；另有希利蓋農語、伊洛卡諾語、瓦瑞語、比科爾語、馬京達瑙語等。關鍵字需含在地詞彙（lagnat、sinat、tawa-tawa）。已有菲語 LLM 評測 Batayan；區域語言屬低資源。

imps.title: Blind spots: BARMM, GIDA, typhoon zones
imps.detail: BARMM 40% individuals online, no online news sites, functional literacy 64.7% (lowest region is Zamboanga Peninsula, 59.3%); 247 municipalities lost connectivity after Typhoon Rai. Rely on DOH ESR/BHW reporting there [INF].
imps.dZh: BARMM 個人上網率 40%、無本地線上新聞網站、功能性識字率 64.7%（全國最低為三寶顏半島 59.3%）；奧黛特颱風後 247 個市失去連線。這些地區須仰賴衛生部 ESR／BHW 通報 [INF]。

imps.title: Align with existing DOH ESR and FASSSTER
imps.detail: ESR (since 2004) does daily media capture with 24h verification; FASSSTER integrates PIDSR, EMR, SMS and Twitter.
imps.tZh: 與衛生部 ESR 及 FASSSTER 對接
imps.dZh: ESR（2004 年起）每日擷取媒體並於 24 小時內查證；FASSSTER 整合 PIDSR、電子病歷、簡訊與 Twitter。

imps.title: Credibility scoring for noisy/adversarial content
imps.detail: Impostor DOH pages, spoofed alerts, troll networks, vaccine-death rumours (Dengvaxia legacy) — treat rumours as their own signal class [INF].
imps.tZh: 對雜訊／對抗性內容進行可信度評分
imps.dZh: 冒名衛生部粉專、偽造警報、網軍、疫苗致死謠言（Dengvaxia 遺緒）——謠言應自成一類訊號 [INF]。

imps.title: Survey representativeness
imps.detail: DNR is an online panel (n~2,000) and overstates digital habits; prefer PSA/Pulse Asia face-to-face data for population inference.
imps.dZh: DNR 為線上樣本（n≈2,000），高估數位習慣；推估母體宜優先採用 PSA／Pulse Asia 面訪資料。

systems.n: Philippine Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response (case-based notifiable disease surveillance); current information system = Epidemic-prone Disease Case Surveillance Information System
systems.nZh: 菲律賓整合性疾病監測與應變系統（法定傳染病個案通報；現行資訊系統 EDCS-IS）

m.frequency: Cat I 24 h; Cat II weekly

f.owner: DOH Epidemiology Bureau (EB), Public Health Surveillance Division; data captured by local ESUs [S01][S02][S05]
type: syndromic (ABD, AHF, AMES, ILI, SARI components)
f.diseases: 2007 software covered 10 immediately reportable + 14 weekly notifiable diseases/syndromes [S10]; 2015 description: Category 1 = 11 diseases reported daily, Category 2 = 14 weekly [S06]; 2018 JEE: '19 notifiable diseases' plus syndromic surveillance for acute bloody diarrhoea, acute haemorrhagic fever, acute meningo-encephalitis syndrome, SARI and ILI [S01]. Case forms in the 2020 IRR include rabies, measles/rubella, AFP, SARI/ILI, malaria, diphtheria, neonatal tetanus, pertussis, meningococcal disease, dengue, chikungunya, AMES, acute bloody diarrhoea, acute viral hepatitis [S05]; leptospirosis, typhoid and cholera are also reported through PIDSR/EDCS [S56][S57][S58]. The current (AO 2021-0057) official list was not retrieved - exact current count unverified.
f.data_fields: Case Investigation Form (Cat I) / Case Report Form (Cat II): DRU name, DRU type (RHU/CHO, govt/private hospital, clinic, lab, airport/seaport), patient number, EPI ID (some forms), name, sex, DOB, age, current and permanent address (house no., street/purok, barangay, municipality/city, province, region), occupation, IP group, pregnancy, dates of consult/admission, onset, report, investigation, reporter/investigator contacts, outcome (alive/died + date), final classification [S05]. Facility codes from the National Health Facility Registry required [S05].
f.granularity: Patient address to barangay; reporting unit = facility (DRU); published aggregates usually region/province/HUC [S05][S70]
f.reporting_flow: DRU (RHU/hospital/clinic/lab/port) -> MESU/CESU -> PESU -> RESU (under DOH regional office/CHD) -> EB [S01][S05][S10]; Cat I CIF must go to LESU, RESU and EB within 24 h [S05]
f.frequency: Category I: within 24 h of detection; Category II: weekly every Friday [S05]; EB analyses weekly; DOH press reporting uses 2-week morbidity windows [S70][S71]
f.lag: WHO WPRO: 'reporting delays of 2-3 weeks' for PIDSR dengue data [S13][S93]; 2018 JEE: 'major reporting delays for measles' [S01]
f.coverage: In 2007 the sentinel system was expanded to 'up to 1662 disease reporting units' [S11]; 2018 JEE: data sources are government health facilities [S01]. Current number of DRUs and national completeness/timeliness KPIs: not published (unverified). Post-Haiyan Region 8 dengue timeliness 13-63% and reporting rate 2-50% vs 80% target [S07].
f.tech: 2007: Visual Basic + Epi Info data-entry software; MS Office Groove 'Online Data Management System'; pidsr.net.ph [S10]. Later: offline PIDSR-IS application, replaced by web-based EDCS-IS [S08]; 'Online PIDSR Information System' DM 2022-0006 [S02]. 2018 JEE: online tool but data entered offline; manual validation and lab linkage [S01].
f.ai_ml: None documented by DOH. Third-party academic ML forecasting on PIDSR/EB data exists (e.g., [S84][S110]) - not operational.
f.public_access: DOH 'Weekly Disease Surveillance Report' pages (fetch blocked) [S111]; EB weekly highlight / epidemiological bulletin [S02]; EDCS annual report page on EB portal [S81]; DOH press briefings with 2-week figures [S70][S71]; line-level data only via FOI requests [S109]; no API found (unverified). Third-party mirror: HDX dengue 2016-2021 from EB [S80].
f.legal_basis: RA 11332 (2019) and 2020 Revised IRR [S04][S05]; AO 2007-0036 (PIDSR guidelines, 1 Oct 2007) [S10]; AO 2021-0057 Revised PIDSR Guidelines [S02]; PIDSR Manual of Procedures 3rd ed. 2014 [S85].
f.limitations: No unique case ID / manual de-duplication and lab linkage [S01]; incomplete private-sector reporting [S01]; case definitions not followed (typhoid pseudo-outbreak: 7.2% of reviewed cases met definition) [S56]; statistical anomalies (Benford) in most diseases [S58]; dengue reporting rate ~21% (expansion factor 4.7) [S12]; reporting suspended for up to 7-10 weeks after Typhoon Haiyan [S07]; fragmented information systems [S02].
f.year_established: 2007 (AO 2007-0036); MOP approved March 2008 [S10]; redesigned as case-based system 2008 [S06]

systems.fc: Fact-check: the "~21% dengue reporting rate" is Undurraga et al. 2017 (active vs passive surveillance in one barangay, Punta Princesa, Cebu City) — not a national or WHO WPRO figure. The typhoid 7.2% refers to one 2022 Benguet pseudo-outbreak (15/208 reviewed cases). The 24 h / weekly reporting rule is set by the 2020 Revised IRR (Rule VI Sec 5), not by RA 11332 itself.
systems.fcZh: 事實查核：「登革熱通報率約 21%」出自 Undurraga 等（2017）於宿霧市單一巴朗蓋（Punta Princesa）主被動監測比較，非全國或 WHO 西太平洋區署數據。傷寒 7.2% 僅指 2022 年本格特省單一假性群聚（208 例中 15 例）。24 小時／每週通報規定出自 2020 年修訂施行細則（Rule VI Sec 5），非 RA 11332 本文。

model.suluCaveat: Supreme Court (9 Sep 2024) held Sulu is not part of BARMM. 2024 POPCEN and PSGC 3Q 2026 place Sulu in Region IX; PSA 2023 poverty still lists Sulu under BARMM; 2024 GRDP BARMM appears to include Sulu (implied population = 386,128M / 73,030 = ~5.29M > BARMM POPCEN 4.55M; Region IX implied ~4.04M < POPCEN 5.09M). Treat BARMM/IX cross-indicator comparisons with care.

regions.conv: Each numeric field is {value, src, year[, note, primary, confidence, inputs]}. src 'D' = derived by researcher; 'A' = approximate; 'Q' = qualitative; null value = not found. Region ids are 2-digit PSGC region codes; psgc is the 10-digit code.

mapSource.codeFormat: integer PSGC without leading zero, e.g. 100000000 = Region I, 1300000000 = NCR, 1800000000 = NIR, 1900000000 = BARMM
